protocol: Three seeds. Each selective arm evaluates the same number of proposals on development data only. Untouched, random, scaling, direction, direct, program and hybrid arms are included. Direct and program apply one head-scale grid. No final-set failures are used to choose edits.

bin_majority.grader: teacher-forced accuracy and mean NLL over every target token
bin_majority.interpretation: Held-out accuracy and NLL must both improve on every seed before a method is listed. Every target token is scored. A first-token match is not a full-span success. A single-seed or NLL-only change is not superiority.

language_model.identity: The restored fingerprint equals the undo package before_sha256. The smoke report names this model and revision and records that undo restored the original hash. This run did not re-download the hub snapshot.

passage.author: Jane Austen
passage.note: Chapter I is development, Chapter III is held-out, and Chapter X is collateral. Illustration captions and 1894 copyright lines were removed. Windows drawn from these chapters are disjoint across seeds. This is not a benchmark leaderboard.

language_model.grader: teacher-forced accuracy and mean NLL over every target token
language_model.interpretation: One-target next-token windows from three disjoint public-domain chapters. Each seed receives a different slice. Development selects; held-out and collateral are scored once. An NLL-only change is not a capability gain. This is separate from the repeated-window result and from symbolic rule rewriting.

grok_agent.reason: baseline arms do not call an external agent
